instructions.name: ABS
instructions.description: Absolute value of a number.

instructions.name: MIN
instructions.description: Smallest of the inputs.

instructions.name: MAX
instructions.description: Largest of the inputs.

instructions.name: LIMIT
instructions.description: Clamps a value between a lower and an upper limit.

instructions.name: SQR
instructions.description: Square of a floating-point number.

instructions.name: SQRT
instructions.description: Square root of a floating-point number.

instructions.name: LN
instructions.description: Natural logarithm.

instructions.name: EXP
instructions.description: e raised to the input.

instructions.name: SIN
instructions.description: Sine of an angle in radians.

instructions.name: COS
instructions.description: Cosine of an angle in radians.

instructions.name: TAN
instructions.description: Tangent of an angle in radians.

instructions.name: ASIN
instructions.description: Arc sine, result in radians.

instructions.name: ACOS
instructions.description: Arc cosine, result in radians.

instructions.name: ATAN
instructions.description: Arc tangent, result in radians.

instructions.name: FRAC
instructions.description: Fractional part of a floating-point number.

instructions.name: EXPT
instructions.description: Raises the first input to the power of the second.

instructions.name: ROUND
instructions.description: Rounds to the nearest whole number; halves go to the even neighbour.

instructions.name: TRUNC
instructions.description: Drops the fractional part (rounds toward zero).

instructions.name: CEIL
instructions.description: Rounds up to the next whole number.

instructions.name: FLOOR
instructions.description: Rounds down to the next whole number.

instructions.name: NORM_X
instructions.description: Maps a value from its range onto 0.0 to 1.0.

instructions.name: SCALE_X
instructions.description: Maps a value from 0.0 to 1.0 onto a target range.

instructions.name: SEL
instructions.description: Returns IN1 when G is true, otherwise IN0.

instructions.name: MUX
instructions.description: Returns the input selected by K.

instructions.name: SHL
instructions.description: Shifts bits to the left by N places.

instructions.name: SHR
instructions.description: Shifts bits to the right by N places.

instructions.name: ROL
instructions.description: Rotates bits to the left by N places.

instructions.name: ROR
instructions.description: Rotates bits to the right by N places.

instructions.name: SWAP
instructions.description: Reverses the byte order.

instructions.name: MOVE_BLK
instructions.description: Copies part of an array into another array of the same element type.

instructions.name: UMOVE_BLK
instructions.description: Like MOVE_BLK, but cannot be interrupted.

instructions.name: FILL_BLK
instructions.description: Fills part of an array with one value.

instructions.name: MOVE_BLK_VARIANT
instructions.description: Copies array elements whose type is known only at run time.

instructions.name: Serialize
instructions.description: Writes a structured value into a byte array.

instructions.name: Deserialize
instructions.description: Reads a structured value from a byte array.

instructions.name: LEN
instructions.description: Current length of a string.

instructions.name: CONCAT
instructions.description: Joins two strings.

instructions.name: LEFT
instructions.description: First L characters of a string.

instructions.name: RIGHT
instructions.description: Last L characters of a string.

instructions.name: MID
instructions.description: L characters of a string, starting at position P (1-based).

instructions.name: DELETE
instructions.description: Removes L characters from a string, starting at position P.

instructions.name: INSERT
instructions.description: Inserts the second string into the first after position P.

instructions.name: REPLACE
instructions.description: Replaces L characters of the first string, from position P, with the second string.

instructions.name: FIND
instructions.description: Position of the second string in the first; 0 when absent.

instructions.name: TypeOf
instructions.description: Data type of the value a Variant points at; used as a CASE selector.

instructions.name: TypeOfElements
instructions.description: Element type of the array a Variant points at.

instructions.name: REF
instructions.description: Reference to a variable, for a REF_TO tag.

instructions.name: LOWER_BOUND
instructions.description: Lower index limit of an Array[*] in one dimension.

instructions.name: UPPER_BOUND
instructions.description: Upper index limit of an Array[*] in one dimension.

instructions.name: CountOfElements
instructions.description: Number of elements of the array a Variant points at.

instructions.name: IS_NULL
instructions.description: True when a Variant points at nothing.

instructions.name: NOT_NULL
instructions.description: True when a Variant points at something.

instructions.name: GET_ERR_ID
instructions.description: Id of the last local program error; 0 when none.

instructions.name: GET_ERROR
instructions.description: Full information about the last local program error.

instructions.name: RD_SYS_T
instructions.description: Reads the module time (UTC).

instructions.name: RD_LOC_T
instructions.description: Reads the local time, daylight saving included.

instructions.name: WR_SYS_T
instructions.description: Sets the module time.

instructions.name: T_ADD
instructions.description: Adds a duration to a time or date.

instructions.name: T_SUB
instructions.description: Subtracts a duration from a time or date.

instructions.name: T_DIFF
instructions.description: Difference between two points in time.

instructions.name: T_COMBINE
instructions.description: Builds a date-and-time value from a date and a time of day.

instructions.name: T_CONV
instructions.description: Converts between time and date types.

instructions.name: IN_RANGE
instructions.description: True when the value lies between the limits.

instructions.name: OUT_RANGE
instructions.description: True when the value lies outside the limits.

instructions.name: TON
instructions.description: Switches the output on once the input has been on for the preset time.

instructions.name: TOF
instructions.description: Keeps the output on for the preset time after the input goes off.

instructions.name: TP
instructions.description: Produces a pulse of the preset length on a rising input.

instructions.name: TONR
instructions.description: Accumulates on-time until the preset is reached; R clears it.

instructions.name: CTU
instructions.description: Counts rising edges up to the preset.

instructions.name: CTD
instructions.description: Counts rising edges down from the preset.

instructions.name: CTUD
instructions.description: Counts up and down on rising edges.

instructions.name: R_TRIG
instructions.description: True for one call when the input rises.

instructions.name: F_TRIG
instructions.description: True for one call when the input falls.

ladderElements.name: Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when the operand is true.

ladderElements.name: I_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when the operand is false.

ladderElements.name: P_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power for one cycle when the operand rises; bit keeps the previous state.

ladderElements.name: N_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power for one cycle when the operand falls; bit keeps the previous state.

ladderElements.name: Coil
ladderElements.description: Writes the incoming power to the operand.

ladderElements.name: I_Coil
ladderElements.description: Writes the negated incoming power to the operand.

ladderElements.name: S_Coil
ladderElements.description: Sets the operand to true while power flows.

ladderElements.name: R_Coil
ladderElements.description: Resets the operand to false while power flows.

ladderElements.name: P_Coil
ladderElements.description: Sets the operand for one cycle when the incoming power rises.

ladderElements.name: N_Coil
ladderElements.description: Sets the operand for one cycle when the incoming power falls.

verification.note: spelling taken from P_Coil; no corpus sample yet

ladderElements.name: EQ_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when both inputs are equal.

ladderElements.name: NE_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when the inputs differ.

ladderElements.name: GT_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when in1 is greater than in2.

ladderElements.name: GE_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when in1 is greater than or equal to in2.

ladderElements.name: LT_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when in1 is less than in2.

ladderElements.name: LE_Contact
ladderElements.description: Passes power when in1 is less than or equal to in2.

ladderElements.name: Move
ladderElements.description: Copies the input to the outputs.

ladderElements.name: Add
ladderElements.description: Adds the inputs.

ladderElements.name: Sub
ladderElements.description: Subtracts in2 from in1.

ladderElements.name: Mul
ladderElements.description: Multiplies the inputs.

ladderElements.name: Div
ladderElements.description: Divides in1 by in2.

ladderElements.name: JumpCoil
ladderElements.description: Jumps to the label when power flows.

ladderElements.name: A
ladderElements.description: AND of the inputs.

ladderElements.name: O
ladderElements.description: OR of the inputs.

ladderElements.name: X
ladderElements.description: Exclusive OR of the inputs.

ladderElements.name: S_SR
ladderElements.description: Set/reset flip-flop; reset wins.

ladderElements.name: S_RS
ladderElements.description: Reset/set flip-flop; set wins.

ladderElements.name: P_Trig
ladderElements.description: True for one cycle when the incoming signal rises.

ladderElements.name: N_Trig
ladderElements.description: True for one cycle when the incoming signal falls.

ladderElements.name: Abs
ladderElements.description: Absolute value of the input.

ladderElements.name: Neg
ladderElements.description: The input with its sign inverted.

ladderElements.name: Mod
ladderElements.description: Remainder of in1 divided by in2.

ladderElements.name: Sel
ladderElements.description: Passes in0 while g is FALSE and in1 while g is TRUE.

ladderElements.name: Convert
ladderElements.description: Converts the input to the output's data type; both types must be chosen.

ladderElements.name: MAX
ladderElements.description: The larger of the inputs.

ladderElements.name: MIN
ladderElements.description: The smaller of the inputs.

ladderElements.name: Limit
ladderElements.description: The input kept between min and max.
